thread:
Ravi (Head of Product): Thanks for coming to today’s all-hands — quick follow-up thread for Q&A items we couldn’t get to live. I’ll collect links and owners here.

Claire (CEO): Big thanks to everyone — two notes: 1) we’re prioritizing Private pilot for regulated customers; 2) Dedicated capacity roadmap is unchanged but we’ll add more visibility into capacity SLAs.

Jordan (Eng): Quick clarification: is the Private pilot expected to require on-prem hardware or is VPC-only okay for most customers?

Claire (CEO): VPC-first for most pilots. On-prem (air-gapped) is available for a smaller set of customers — we’ll be explicit about eligibility in the follow-up doc. Target: pilot start Q3 2025, wider availability late Q4 2025. :calendar:

Alex (Platform): Link to the draft Private runbook: https://internal.redwood.dev/runbooks/private-pilot (comments open). I’ve added the network prerequisites and KMS integration checklist.

Priya (Solutions): For sales folks: I’ll run a short enablement session next week (Thu 11am PT) covering when to position VPC vs on-prem and expected SW/hardware lead times. RSVP: https://cal.link/priya-private-brief

Jordan (Eng): Roadmap note: we mentioned kernel selection improvements and batching optimizations. Any concrete perf targets we can share with customers?

Ravi (Head of Product): Yes — for gen workloads we’re aiming for 30–40% latency reduction over current baseline on Dedicated by the end of H2. We’ll publish perf numbers per model in the benchmarks doc next week.

Alex (Platform): Action item: add a per-model latency & cost table to the benchmarks doc. Owner: @Alex. ETA: 7 days.

OpsBot: Recording and transcript uploaded: https://internal.redwood.dev/all-hands/recordings/1719304821 — captions available.

Priya (Solutions): Customer ask: can we commit to support for bring-your-own-models in Redwood Dedicated? What’s the path?

Ravi (Head of Product): Short answer: yes — BYOM is on the roadmap. We’ll have a gated beta for Dedicated customers in Q4 2025. More detail in the product note I’ll post tomorrow.

Jordan (Eng): Follow-up technical Q: how will we handle model pinning + automatic fallbacks? We need outlines for ops runbooks.

Alex (Platform): We plan to expose rollout policies in the Console (canary/A-B/fallback). Ops runbook draft is in the runbooks folder — I’ll add a section for model pinning and fallback chains. Owner: @Alex. ETA: 10 days.

Claire (CEO): People asked about hiring priorities — engineering infra, SRE, and applied ML. We’re fast-tracking a couple of IC hires; hiring team will post JD links tomorrow.

Ravi (Head of Product): Action items summary (I’ll paste to the product board):
- Alex: add per-model latency & cost table to benchmarks (7d)
- Alex: ops runbook section for model pinning/fallback (10d)
- Priya: enablement for sales on Private positioning (Thu 11am PT)
- Ravi: product note on BYOM + timeline (tomorrow)
- Claire/People Ops: publish hiring JDs (tomorrow)

Jordan (Eng): Small doc question: where should engineers file follow-up bugs/tasks from the all-hands demos?

Priya (Solutions): Use the "all-hands-followups" project on Linear and tag with team (eng/infra/product). I’ll make the template.

Ravi (Head of Product): We’ll hold an open office hours for deeper Q&A Friday 4pm PT — drop questions here or in the Linear template if you want to reserve a slot.

Alex (Platform): Added a short FAQ to the runbook for network/public IP concerns: https://internal.redwood.dev/runbooks/private-pilot#faq — please review.

Jordan (Eng): One more ask from infra: can we get clarification on hardware procurement timelines for Dedicated GPUs for Q4 pilots?

Claire (CEO): We will share procurement timelines with sales and ops by EOD Monday. Short version: order windows close mid-Q3 for Q4 delivery on some SKUs.

Priya (Solutions): If anyone has customer-facing follow-ups that need copy/text, ping me and I’ll draft a short FAQ blurb.

Ravi (Head of Product): Thanks — I’ll consolidate this thread into a short follow-up doc and post to #eng and #sales by EOD. Cheers everyone. :rocket:
